tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa bkra shis brtsegs pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bzhugs so/// /

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya maṅga la ku ṭa nā ma ma hā yā na sū tra/ bod skad du 'phags pa bkra shis brtsegs pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das ri bo mchog gi gnas/ bkra shis brtsegs ba'i pho brang*/ me tog brtsegs pa'i tshal/ rdo rje brtsegs pa'i gur khang*/ rin chen spungs pa'i khri/ ge sar pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te/ bkra shis pa'i 'khor mang po dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po stong rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' bkra shis mchog dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' bkra shis sdud dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' bkra shis rgyan dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' bkra shis kun tu gzigs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' bkra shis yongs su khyab dang*/ bkra shis byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ bkra shis byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po dang*/ bkra shis byang chub sems dpa' rlung gi snying po dang*/ bkra shis byang chub sems dpa' me'i snying po dang*/ bkra shis byang chub sems dpa' chu'i snying po dang*/ bkra shis byang chub sems dpa' rdo'i snying po dang*/ bkra shis byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i snying po dang*/ bkra shis byang chub sems dpa' bkod pa mtha' yas dang*/ de bzhin du rnam par gzigs dang*/ blo gros mchog dang*/ 'od dpag med dang*/ tshe dpag med dang*/ sangs rgyas 'od srung dang*/ bkra shis dam pa'i tog can dang*/ bkra shis mthu stobs dang ldan pa lag na rdo rje dang*/ bkra shis mkhyen pa dang ldan pa 'jam dpal dang*/ bkra shis thugs rje dang ldan pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ shā ri'i bu dang*/ rab 'byor la sogs pa bkra shis pa'i 'khor stong rtsa brgyad dang*/ gzhan yang lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ grul bum dang*/

mi dang mi ma yin pa'i tshogs rab tu mang po dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ de'i tshe de'i dus na 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das la bskor ba mang du mdzad de/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das bkra shis dang ldan pa'i 'khor mang po bzhugs pa'i skabs 'dir thog mar bkra shis shing dge ba/ bar du bkra shis shing dge ba/ mtha' mar bkra shis shing dge ba/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad zhi bar byed pa/ bkra shis pa thams cad yongs su 'du bar byed pa/ nyes skyon sel ba legs pa'i yon tan thams cad yongs su 'du bar byed pa/ dpal dang skal ba bzang por byed pa'i mdo zhig bstan du gsol/ zhes zhus pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas/ 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to// 'jam dpal gzhan yang bkra shis dang ldan pa'i 'khor rnams nyon cig /ngas sngon bram ze'i lus kyis mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir tshe lo stong thub pa'i tshe/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bkra shis thams cad 'byung ba'i dpal gzi brjid ces bya ba la bkra shis brtsegs pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ yon tan stong ldan zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos te/ bzung zhing bcangs te bklags shing bshad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di la legs nyes kyi dbang gis bkra mi shis pa'i rtags mang du byung ste/ dus tshod nyes pa dang*/ skye ba nyes pa dang*/ lo zla mi shis pa la sogs pa dang*/ las bya nyes pa dang*/ zas za nyes pa dang*/ gos btsem nyes pa dang*/ khyim dbubs nyes pa dang*/ grogs btsal nyes pa dang*/ nor bsrel nyes pa dang*/ rta phyugs bsrel nyes pa dang*/ na nyes pa dang*/ shi nyes pa dang*/ lam du 'jug pa nyes pa dang*/ ro drangs nyes pa dang*/ gshid bya nyes pa dang*/ dur gdab pa la sogs te bkra mi shis pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/

bkra shis pa thams cad rab tu 'du bar byed pa/ nyes skyon thams cad rab tu sel ba/ legs pa'i yon tan thams cad yongs su 'du bar byed pa/ dpal dang skal ba bzang por gyur pa/ thog mtha' bar du dge ba/ bsod nams thams cad yongs su sdud pa/ bkra shis kyi tshogs thams cad 'char zhing shes pa/ sdig sgrib thams cad med par 'phags pa/ bkra shis brtsegs pa chen po'i mdo ngas khyod la bstan gyis/ 'di thos sam brtsams shing brjod pa tsam gyis/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ mo ngan pa dang*/ dmigs ltas ngan pa dang*/ pra brtags ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa thams cad zlog par byed pa'i mdo sde sems can thams cad la phan pa dang*/ sman pa dang*/ bde ba'i phyir khyod la ngas bstan gyis rab tu nyon la yid la chongs shig ces bka' bstsal to// de la 'jam dpal gyis legs so legs so// bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad kyi bkra mi shis pa thams cad zlog par byed pa'i don du/ bkra shis brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i mdo sde yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po chos kyi phung po de bdag cag rnams la bshad du gsol zhes zhus pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal gzhan yang bkra shis dang ldan pa'i 'khor dag skye 'gro mtha' dag la las dang*/ bsod nams 'phel shugs kyis bkra shis pa dang*/ bkra mi shis pa gnyis su byung ste/ sems can gyi nang nas kyang mi'i rigs su gyur pa la/ bkra mi shis pa'i rtags ni klog nyes pa dang*/ bris nyes pa dang*/ bshad nyes pa dang*/ sgom nyes pa dang*/ skyes ma thag tu 'chi ba dang*/ dmus long can dang*/ sha bkra can dang*// glang sha sha ro dang*/ sho re dwa sgal zhar sgur dang*// gzi mig drug lag gdong sme can// lba ba sha lhag sha mtshan dang*/ gtsug ngan pa dang sha 'dzer can// yan lag chad lhag byung ba rnams// bkra mi shis pa'i skyon yin te// de bzhin phyugs dang sgo khyi dang*// zhing khang nor rdzas kun la yang*// bkra mi shis pa'i skyon mang du byung ste// de yi mtshan ma ngan pa dang*// rtags sogs bkra mi shis pa kun// thams cad zlog cing bsgyur ba ste// nyes skyon med par bya ba'i phyir// bkra shis don gyi lha lnga la phyag 'tshal lo// bkra shis mchog gi lha phyogs skyong mgon po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bkra shis par byed pa'i sngags brjod par bya'o// s+yād+ya the dan/

bhi dz+nyāk+s+ya ye bhi dz+nyā ye/ ug ge ug gi swa sti kra pa ti/ u mu kha hi pra swa ra dwa/ swa sti swa sti bruṃ bruṃ bruṃ pra hak+ṣe/ mu ne mu ne/ gu ra ne gu ra ne/ a khe mu khe/ mu ra ke mu ra ke /a ma tu gu ra na ya/ swa sti swa sti swa swasti/ gu le mu le/ ke she ke she/ tsu ra na tsu ra na/ bhi ra ma le swā hā/ zhes tshig 'di rab tu brjod do// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol shis gyur cig /phyi nang gsang ba'i bkra shis rnams// deng 'dir 'byung zhing 'bab gyur cig /phyi ru bkra shis nam mkha' dag pa'i mkha'// nang du bkra shis sems nyid dag pa'i klong*// gsang ba'i bkra shis chos nyid dag pa'i dbyings// mkha' klong dbyings gsum bkra shis gang yin pa/ bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gnam la bkra shis nyi zla gnyis// gza' skar mang po'i tshogs kyis bskor/ sa la bkra shis 'byung ba lnga// me chu sa rlung tshogs kyis bskor// bar na bkra shis dkon mchog gsum// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas tshogs kyis bskor// dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /na mo bud+dha ya/ na mo dharma ya/ na ma saṅgha ya/ gnam sa bar gyi bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis de sa kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /dbus na bkra shis don gyi lha// rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis don gyi lha// rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /shar na bkra shis don gyi lha// rdo rje sems dpa'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lho na bkra shis don gyi lha// rin chen 'byung gnas bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nub na bkra shis don gyi lha// snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/byang na bkra shis don gyi lha// don yod grub pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /oṃ bud+dha ya dhu/ oṃ badz+ra ya dhu/ oṃ rat+na ya dhu/ oṃ pad+ma ya dhu/ oṃ karmā ya dhu/ bdag dang skal ldan rigs kyi bu// deng gi rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin brlabs nas// bkra shis dam pa'i mdo sde 'di// nga yis brjod pa'i bsod nams kyis// nam mkha' lta bu kun khyab cing*/ nyi zla lta bur kun gsal te// skar tshogs lta bur grangs mang zhing*// sprin tshogs lta bur lhun grub ste// 'ja' tshon lta bur mdzes sdug cing*// ri rab lta bur brtan brjid che// sa gzhi lta bur kun bskyed cing*// rgya mtsho lta bur gting zab pa'i// ljon shing lta bur 'dab rgyas te// yid bzhin nor bu rin chen ltar// dgos 'dod bkra shis char ltar 'bab gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rat+na bruṃ ni a/ bkra shis par gyur cig /dmigs pa med pa sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin// sbyin pa chen po'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde lags shog /'chal ba med pa tshul khrims pha rol phyin// tshul khrims chen po'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /byung tshor med pa bzod pa'i pha rol phyin// bzod pa chen po'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /le lo med pa brtson 'grus pha rol phyin// brtson 'grus chen po'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /'gyur ldog med pa bsam gtan pha rol phyin// bsam gtan chen po'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gang yang ma 'gags thabs kyi pha rol phyin// thabs chen mchog gi bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ma chags thogs med stobs kyi pha rol phyin// stobs chen shugs kyi bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/re dogs med pa smon lam pha rol phyin// smon lam chen po'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /'khrul pa med pa shes rab pha rol phyin// shes rab chen po'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /pha rol phyin bcu'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bde legs thams cad myur thob shog /oṃ swa sti/ tad+ya thā/ ga te ga te/ pā ra ga te/ pā ra saṅga te bo dhi swā hā// ma chags thogs med 'khor lo rin po che// 'khor lo rin chen bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /theg chen stobs ldan glang po che// glang po rin chen bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /cang shes shugs ldan rta mchog rin po che// rta mchog rin chen bkra shis gang yin pa/ bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /kun la dbang bsgyur blon po rin po che// blon po rin chen bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /log rtog dpung 'joms dmag dpon rin po che// dmag dpon rin chen bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /thams cad kun skyed btsun mo rin po che// btsun mo rin chen bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /de ma thag tu bdag cag bde legs shog /bsam 'phel don grub nor bu rin po che/ nor bu rin chen bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /oṃ bhe shi ti/ rat+na bhe shi ti/ saṃ mud gti se swā hā/ oṃ bar+ya su le bha ma khraṃ tse/ smra ra ts+tshe da nāñdze swā hā/ na mo dbu la bkra shis gdugs ltar skyobs// sku la bkra shis mi nub rgyal mtshan mchog /gsung la bkra shis chos dung g.yas su 'khyil// thugs la bkra shis dpal gyi be 'u gsal// spyan la bkra shis rin chen gser gyi nya// ljags la bkra shis pad+mo lo 'dab rgyas// mgul la bkra shis rin chen bum pa 'khyil// phyag la bkra shis yon tan nor bu mchog

/zhabs la bkra shis 'phrin las 'khor lo mnga'// bkra shis rdzas brgyad dngos grub dam pa'i mchog /rdzas mchog brgyad kyi bkra shis gang yin pa// deng 'dir bdag cag rnams la bkra shis phob// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /oṃ sarba ā yur+dz+nyā na rat+na ha mu ki /bruṃ bruṃ bruṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ swa sti/ sangs rgyas zhal nas gsungs pa yi// bkra shis brtsegs pa'i smon lam mdo// tshe 'dir bde skyid tshe ring zhing*// bkra shis dpal dang longs spyod thob// bsod nams phun sum tshogs ldan thob// phyi ma bla med rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa dang*/ bkra shis dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang*/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la rjes su yi rangs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par bstod do// de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo sde 'di'i ji ltar las cho ga dang ldan par bgyi/ de'i cho ga ni ji ltar bgyi zhes gsol pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal 'di'i cho ga ni dkon mchog gi pho brang bzhengs pa dang*/ lha khang bzhengs pa dang*/ gtsug la khang bzhengs pa dang*/ mchod rten bzhengs pa dang*/ bum pa bzhengs pa dang*/ sku gdung dang*/ gsung rabs dang*/ glegs bam la rab gnas byed pa dang*/ yul mkhar gang du rtsig pa dang*/ khang khyim gsar pa 'bubs pa dang*/ bu khye'u btsas pa dang*/ bag ma gtong len byed pa dang*/ ro 'don pa dang*/ gshid byed pa dang*/ dur gdab pa dang*/ bkra mi shis pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dag zlog par byed pa/ sgyur bar byed pa 'di ni kha zas gtsang zhing ro bro bar byed pa'am/ nas 'bras til la sogs pa'i 'bru sna lnga'am/ shing thog gam/ 'bru bcud dam/ sbrang rtsi'am/ 'brang rgyas lta bu la brjod par bya'o// de'i phan yon ni bkra mi shis pa thams cad rab tu zhi nas/

tshe 'dir bkra shis kun ldan zhing*/ bla med 'bras bu thob ces bka' bstsal to// sku yi bkra shis skye med chos kyi sku// gsung gi bkra shis dam chos bdud rtsi'i sgra// thugs kyi bkra shis mnyam nyid 'khrul pa med// yon tan bkra shis 'gro drug gnas nas 'dren// phrin las bkra shis rtsol med lhun gyis grub// nyin yang bkra shis mtshan yang bkra shis shog /nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis bde legs shog /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /da ltar byung rnams bde legs shog /kun kyang bde skyid mchog thob shog /oṃ skam ka ra skam ka ra nir gad tsa ta// oṃ swa sti/ 'phags pa bkra shis brtsegs pa chen po'i mdo las cho ga dang bcas pa rdzogs so/// /shis par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// lha yi bkra shis don grub cing*// phyogs rnams bkra shis byed pa des// khyed kyi don rnams grub gyur cig /thams cad myur du mthun par shog /phreng ba mgo la 'dug pa ltar// lag pa g.yas na dpal yod shog /g.yon na'ang dpal ni gnas gyur cig /yan lag kun la'ang dpal yod shog /tshong pa dag ni nor 'tshol zhing*// phyogs bcu dag tu 'gro ba rnams// rnyed pa chen po rnyed gyur cig /de dag bde ba skyid par shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir// shar phyogs su ni 'gro ba na// gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yi// rgyu skar khyed la skyong gyur cig /smin drug dang ni snar ma dang*/ mgo dang lag dang na bas so dang*/ rgyal dang skag ces bya ba ste// de dag rnams ni shar phyogs pa// rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni// 'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa// shar phyogs log na yod ces bstan// de dag khyod la kun du srungs// de dag bdag po rgyal po ni// yul 'khor srung zhes grags pa ste// de ni dri za kun gyi bdag /nyi ma lhan cig srung bar shog

/de la bu ni mang yod la// mkhas shing ming yang mthun pa ste// dgu bcu rtsa gcig zad par yang*// dbang po zhes bya stobs po che// de rnams khyed la nad med cing*// shis pa lhag par skyong gyur cig /shar phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na// lha mo gzhon nu brgyad yod de// rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ma dang*// don grub ma dang mi pham dang*// dga' mchog ma dang dga' ba de dang*// dga' can ma dang dga' 'phel ma// de dag khyed la nad med cing*// shis pa lhag par skyong gyur cig /shar phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na// gzhi 'dzin ces bya'i mchod rten yod/ rgyal ba skyob pa dgra bcom pa// de rnams kyis ni bzhugs shing mkhyen// de yang khyed la nad med cing*// shis pa lhag par skyong gyur cig /phyogs na khyed cag bde bar shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /lha rnams kun gyis rab bsrungs nas/ nor rnams rnyed de ldog par shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir// lho phyogs su ni 'gro ba na// gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yi// rgyu skar khyed la skyong gyur cig /mchu dang gre dang dbo dang ni// me bzhi nag pa lnga pa yin// sa ri dang ni sa ga ste// de dag rnams ni lho phyogs pa// rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni// 'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa// lho phyogs logs na yod ces bstan/ de dag khyed la kun du bsrungs// de dag bdag po rgyal po ni// 'phags skyes po zhes bya bar brjod// de ni grul bum kun gyi bdag /gshin rje lhan cig srung bar shog /de la bu ni mang yod la// mkhas shing ming yang mthun pa ste// dgu bcu rtsa gcig zad par yang*// dbang po zhes bya stobs po che// de rnams khyed la nad med cing*// shis pa lhag par skyong gyur cig /lho phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na// lha mo gzhon nu brgyad yod de// dpal ldan ma dang grags ldan ma// grags pa thob dang grags 'dzin dang*// legs par langs dang rab snga dang*// legs par sad dang bde sgrub ma// de dag khyed la nad med cing*// shis pa lhag par skyong bar shog

/lho phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na// pad+ma zhes bya'i mchod rten yod// rtag tu gzi brjid kyis kyang 'bar// rtag tu thams cad gsal bar byed// de yang khyed la nad med cing*// shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /phyogs na khyed cag bde bar shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /lha rnams kun gyis rab bsrungs nas// nor rnams rnyed de ldog par shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir// nub phyogs su ni 'gro ba na// gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yi// rgyu skar khyed la skyong gyur cig /lha mtshams dang ni snron dang yang*// brtson 'grus brtan ldan snubs dang ni// chu stod chu smad byi bzhin dang*// gro bzhin de ni bdun pa yin// rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni// 'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa// nub phyogs logs na yod ces bstan// de dag khyed la kun du srungs// de dag bdag po rgyal po ni// mig mi bzang zhes bya bar shes// de ni klu rnams kun gyi bdag /chu lha lhan cig srung bar shog /de la bu ni mang yod la// mkhas shing ming yang mthun pa ste// dgu bcu rtsa gcig zad par yang*// dbang po zhes bya stobs pa che// de dag khyed la nad med cing*// shis pa lhag par skyong gyur cig /zhub phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na// lha mo gzhon nu brgyad yod de// rna cha sra mkhregs ma dang ni// pad+ma dkar dang skya rengs dang*// cha med gcig dang dgu pa dang*// rol dang gnag dang stobs myur srid// de dag khyed la nad med cig /shas pa lhag par skyong bar shog /nub phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na// nub ces bya ba'i ri bo yod// nyi ma zla ba gnyis ka'ang nub// nub pa'ang khyed la nor sbyin 'gyur// de yang khyed la nad med cing*// shis pa lhag par skyong gyur cig /phyogs na khyed cag bde bar shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /lha rnams kun gyis rab bsrungs nas// nor rnams rnyed de ldog par shog
